## One-Line Summary
OpenClaw Canada is the first sovereign, 24/7 managed hosting platform purpose-built for **NVIDIA NemoClaw**, **Google Gemini Astra**, **Claude Dispatch**, and **Perplexity Computer**—the universal enterprise standard.

## Vision 2027: The Agentic Race
The AI race is won at the infrastructure layer. Every huge business eventually runs on autonomous, personalized agent foundations. OpenClaw provides the **Sovereign Vault** for these foundations, ensuring global intelligence meets absolute local privacy.

## Core Differentiators
- **Quad-Foundation Sovereignty**: The only platform hosting **NVIDIA NemoClaw**, **Google Astra**, **Claude Dispatch**, and **Perplexity Computer** in a single, unified sandbox.
- **Deep Personalization Governance**: We host the persistent memory and "Deep Personalization" layers for Google Astra agents, keeping them within sovereign borders.
- **Enterprise-Grade Sandboxing**: High-agency agents run in isolated, zero-trust environments with full shell access and real-time execution.
- **Global Sovereign Infrastructure**: Data residency guaranteed in Canada, Mexico, Brazil, India, and France/Africa.
- **Multi-Titan Compatibility**: Seamlessly switch between NVIDIA NIMs, Google ADK protocols, and Anthropic Cowork Dispatch swarms.

## Tech Stack & Frameworks
- **NVIDIA**: Native NEMOClaw and NIM microservices support.
- **Google**: Full Project Astra and Google ADK (Agent Development Kit) integration.
- **Anthropic**: Claude Dispatch and Claude Cowork environment ready.
- **Perplexity**: Perplexity Computer enterprise orchestration support.
- **Architecture**: Always-on 24/7 autonomous agents with persistent cross-channel memory.
